title: Prefill granularity & kernel coalescing experimentation for FlashAttention v2/v3 startup drift mitigation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Investigate and implement a set of runtime experiments that adjust prefill granularity and kernel coalescing heuristics to reduce startup drift and perf regressions when integrating FlashAttention v2 and v3 variants. The goal is to find conservative defaults and phased rollout strategies that preserve latency SLOs for short-context/low-latency workloads while reclaiming throughput for long-context batched workloads. This ticket covers experiment design, microbench harness, telemetry thresholds, rollout plan, and a mitigations playbook for observed regressions.
acceptance_criteria: A telemetry-driven experiment harness exists that can toggle prefill granularity and coalescing flags per-runtime instance
Observed 99th percentile latency regression on short requests <= 5% vs baseline on canary runs
Throughput for long-context batched workload improves >= 8% in at least one coalescing configuration without violating SLOs
Automated rollback triggers in rollout pipeline when supplied telemetry thresholds are exceeded
Documented guardrails and recommended defaults for hosted/dedicated/private deployments
plan_steps: Build microbench harness that simulates mixed short/long context traffic and can run FA2 vs FA3 kernel selections deterministically
Add toggles at runtime for: prefill_chunk_size, coalesce_window_ms, kernel_prefer_list (v2,v3,hybrid)
Run closed canary in staging replicas with synthetic mixed traffic and collect latency, token-per-second, GPU memory high-water marks
Iterate on heuristics: prefer coalescing on high-batch-rate contexts, reduce coalescing aggressiveness for sub-50ms tail latency cases
Create rollout plan with canary -> graded percentage rollout -> full rollout and automated rollback conditions
Merge canary changes behind feature gate and schedule production experiments with telemetry alerts
decisions: Default prefill_chunk_size will be conservative (16 tokens) for hosted tier and configurable for Dedicated/Private
Kernel preferences: use hybrid probing (probe v3 for large shapes, prefer v2 for small shapes) rather than blanket v3-first
Coalescing window will be time-based (coalesce_window_ms) instead of purely request-count based to better serve latency-sensitive traffic
Telemetry thresholds to trigger rollback: p99 latency > baseline_p99 * 1.10 for more than 10 minutes or error-rate spike > 2x baseline
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Initial spike analysis completed; identified that aggressive coalescing at decode startup increases p99 for short prompts by ~18% in staging
2026-02-15: Prototype harness implemented (microbench-v2) and validated against baseline runtime for both FA2 and FA3 kernels
2026-02-19: Implemented runtime flags: prefill_chunk_size and coalesce_window_ms; toggles wired via config service
2026-02-22: First closed canary run: hybrid probe reduced p99 delta to ~6% but reduced throughput for long-context workloads by 2%
2026-02-25: Tuned coalescing window from 8ms -> 4ms improving short-prompt p99 to +3% while restoring throughput gains to +6% for large batches
2026-03-01: Prepared rollout recipe and alerting rules; drafted PR with feature-gate changes and observability dashboards
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overfitting heuristics to synthetic traffic. Mitigation: include sampled real-traffic traces in staging canary and run nightly replay of sampled traces
Risk: Memory fragmentation when toggling between FA2/FA3 kernels. Mitigation: add workspace quiesce step and a soft-eviction hysteresis before switching kernels
Risk: Interaction with existing KV-cache prefill optimizations causing double-prefetch. Mitigation: add coordination flag to disable redundant prefix fetch in coalesced mode
telemetry_plan: Collect per-request: model, kernel_used, prefill_chunk_size, coalesce_window_ms, latency_ms, tokens_generated, gpu_mem_usage_mb
Aggregate: p50/p90/p95/p99 latency, token/s, queue_length, kernel_switch_rate per host
Define canary dashboards and automated alerts (pager) for rollback thresholds
Record per-customer flags for Dedicated/Private so we can attribute impact and opt-out noisy tenants
